source_documents.title: Contribution of radiative rate constants to crystallization-induced emission enhancement in boron-fused azobenzene complexes

reference_evidence_units.quote: it is experimentally proved that a large refractive index in an organic crystal mainly promotes the radiative processes in CIEE even without significant intermolecular electronic interactions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz series

reference_evidence_units.quote: This could be mainly attributed to the higher polarizability of the crystal surrounding, and implied that the molecular planarization and exciton coupling might be minor contributions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: halogenated BAz
reference_evidence_units.statement: Polarizability, not planarization or exciton coupling, explains the kr rise.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the restriction of structural relaxation in the excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz series
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal contacts restrict excited-state structural relaxation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: around a 1.5-fold increase in kr of the halogenated BAz derivatives from the vitrified solution to the crystal was experimentally clarified.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl (with F, Br)

reference_evidence_units.quote: and BAz-Br showed the opposite tendency.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solvent-glass trend of kr differs from BAz-H/F.

reference_evidence_units.quote: ISC should be induced by the external heavy atom eﬀect associated with the multiple molecules in crystal.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl/Br
reference_evidence_units.statement: External heavy-atom ISC as the extra crystal knr.

reference_evidence_units.quote: phosphorescence was not detected at 77 K
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz series

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: CIEE is analysed through kr and knr; the crystal's high refractive index accelerates kr.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: External heavy-atom ISC is proposed for the larger crystal knr; speculative (no phosphorescence), guideline §3.4.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Only generic restriction of structural relaxation is invoked (S3); by guideline §3.3 not labelled (earlier secondary dropped).

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT

mechanism_decisions.rationale: Exciton coupling is judged a minor contribution for the halogenated derivatives (S2), not excluded.

contrast_group.varied_factor: para substituent on the azobenzene rings (H, F, Cl)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Halogens accelerate kr via polarizability; BAz-H's tight H-aggregation suppresses kr.
